title: LATS: Language Agent Tree Search
description: Combines LLMs with Monte Carlo Tree Search. At each node, the agent takes an action (tool call, reasoning step), scores the state with an LLM-based value function, and backtracks when stuck. Outperforms ReAct, Reflexion, and chain-of-thought on HumanEval, WebShop, and HotpotQA. First principled application of MCTS to language agents.
authors: Zhou, Wan, Farahi, Chen, Jiang, Shi, Chen, Tan, Yu, Neubig, Ma, Wu (CMU / Michigan)
